load_experiment_from_csv: load a HiPlot experiment from a CSV file path using the load_csv fetcher function
load_experiment_from_json: load a HiPlot experiment from a JSON file or Nevergrad JSON using the load_json fetcher function
load_fairseq_experiment: load a HiPlot experiment from a fairseq training log file using the fairseq:// URI prefix
load_wav2letter_experiment: load a HiPlot experiment from wav2letter performance metric files using the w2l:// URI prefix
get_fetchers_list: get a list of experiment fetchers including built-in and custom fetchers using get_fetchers with a list of fetcher specs
